population.span: we assigned adults who had been admitted to the intensive care unit (ICU) for severe community-acquired pneumonia

endpoint.span: The primary outcome was death at 28 days.

estimate.span: By day 28, death had occurred in 25 of 400 patients (6.2%; 95% confidence interval [CI], 3.9 to 8.6) in the hydrocortisone group and in 47 of 395 patients (11.9%; 95% CI, 8.7 to 15.1) in the placebo group (absolute difference, -5.6 percentage points; 95% CI, -9.6 to -1.7; P = 0.006).

ci.span: (absolute difference, -5.6 percentage points; 95% CI, -9.6 to -1.7; P = 0.006)

treatment_strategy.span: to receive intravenous hydrocortisone (200 mg daily for either 4 or 7 days as determined by clinical improvement, followed by tapering for a total of 8 or 14 days) or to receive placebo. All the patients received standard therapy, including antibiotics and supportive care.

follow_up.span: The primary outcome was death at 28 days.

absent_reason.analysis_set: The abstract states that 800 patients underwent randomization and data from 795 were analyzed, but no held source identifies the analysis set as ITT, mITT, per-protocol, safety, or all randomized.

served_mismatch: The served arm-level counts match the abstract, but apply to day 28 rather than the specified 30-day or in-hospital timepoint. The served intention-to-treat label is not established by the held sources. The reported between-arm estimate and CI are an absolute risk difference, not an RR; no RR or RR CI is printed.

entry_population_matches_question.why: Adults admitted to an ICU for severe community-acquired pneumonia fall within the question's hospitalized adult population; ITT status remains unverified.
entry_population_matches_question.span: we assigned adults who had been admitted to the intensive care unit (ICU) for severe community-acquired pneumonia

notes: Bindings use the held abstract. BOUND describes the reported day-28 mortality result, not an exact match to the served timepoint or estimand. The CI is for the absolute risk difference; the arm-specific mortality intervals are not RR intervals. No RR was calculated.
